title: Account unlock request: a.fischer
description: Help, typed wrong password 5 times on SSO page. Please unblock acct.

title: Password expired and cannot login: a.fischer
description: My domain password expired over the weekend and I cannot connect to VPN or corporate portal.
resolution_notes: Verified identity with badge ID lookup against HR database. Initiated self-service password reset workflow. Reset Active Directory password with 'Must change at next login' flag. Assisted user with Cisco AnyConnect VPN reconnection.

title: Need ergonomic mouse recommendation

title: Staging test DB desync in dev-sandbox-blue - restore requested
description: Database state in dev-sandbox-blue is inconsistent. FK constraints failing during checkout test. Need reset.
resolution_notes: Terminated active connections to Postgres DB. Restored anonymized schema snapshot v4.2. Restarted backend pods. Verified health check /healthz returned 200 OK.

title: MFA token desync / new device setup for b.williams
description: Got a replacement company laptop/phone and lost Google Authenticator OTP token for b.williams.
resolution_notes: Followed out-of-band identity verification protocol. Sent verification code to registered recovery email. Revoked old MFA tokens and enrolled new hardware token. Tested portal sign-in.
